answer_1.quote: In this paper, we proposed a novel unsupervised approach UPSA that generates paraphrases by simulated annealing.

answer_2.quote: We adopt BLEU and ROUGE scores as automatic metrics to evaluate model performance... we regard the iBLEU score as our major metric.

answer_4.quote: We asked three human annotators to evaluate the generated paraphrases in terms of relevance and fluency; each aspect was scored from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored relevance and fluency on a scale from 1 to 5 for each generated paraphrase.
